CustomField.description: The source system id of the transaction (QuickBooks transaction/line id, or Stripe payment id). Unique so the same transaction can never be staged twice; the same value is stamped onto the gift or payment created on commit (Source_Transaction_Id__c) and checked there too. JSI-121 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The id of this transaction in QuickBooks or Stripe.
CustomField.label: External ID
